description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), create a new sales invoice. Navigate to Sales Invoices > New Sales Invoice. Add two line items (leave the Item field blank if present; fill in Description, Account, Qty, and Unit Price): (1) Description: Consulting Services Q1, Account: Sales (or the income/revenue account shown in the dropdown), Qty: 10, Unit Price: 150.00; (2) Description: Software Support Retainer, Account: Sales, Qty: 1, Unit Price: 500.00. Save the invoice. Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
